g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters An unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted q parameter to /rest/products/search. At routes/search.ts:23 it is concatenated into a raw SQL string, enabling UNION queries that dump users and the schema, and potentially modification of rows or escalation to full database control. The only control is a 200-character truncation, and the route is registered without auth. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access PUT /api/BasketItems/:id at routes/basketItems.ts:68 loads the item by the URL id with no ownership clause and does not compare its basket to the caller; a mismatch only triggers challenge detection. The route has isAuthorized, but ownership is not enforced, so any authenticated user can substitute another user's item id and modify or read their basket items. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Execute Attacker-Controlled Server Code Register an account and log in to obtain a token cookie. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An authenticated user POSTs /dataerasure with a layout body field. At routes/dataErasure.ts:104 the value is resolved and only blocked by a substring deny-list (ftp, ctf.key, encryptionkeys) on the lowercased resolved path. The whole req.body is then spread into res.render options so the layout file is loaded, and the first 100 characters of the rendered output are returned, exposing other local files. A request-controlled path with ../ can read arbitrary files such as /etc/passwd, source or secrets. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication ASI03: getUserId uses security.decode, which only decodes the JWT payload (jws.decode) without verifying the signature. An attacker sends a forged token with another user's data.id; getOrderById and the username lookup then act as that user. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-010) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers An attacker submits a feedback comment containing script or event-handler HTML. The About page wraps the comment in trusted-HTML, so Angular's sanitizer is skipped and the markup runs in every visitor's origin. The script can read the bearer token held in localStorage. C-05 · Angular Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-008) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data
